artifact_observations.location: Front cover central graphics and spine text
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the spine and the script on the cover mimic the structure of language but fail to form legible characters. This 'alien script' effect is a hallmark of AI generation struggling with typography.

The line drawings on the cover appear slightly 'melted' into the background rather than sitting crisply on top of the material. The lines lack consistent thickness and sharpness expected from printed ink.
The top edge shows slight waviness and inconsistent thickness, lacking the perfect straightness of a manufactured rigid object, suggesting minor geometric instability.
